header.description: Two-ship Yak-3 + La-7 envelope-interpolation scenario -- the golden pinning the two roster airframes' generated envelope-table entries in C++ <-> Python lockstep. The ships are near-antipodal (lon 0 vs lon 180, ~47 km apart on the 94 km-circumference sphere) so they can never interact; each flies a profile chosen to traverse its OWN phi_max/roll_rate LUT interpolation segments and its B1/B3/B5 aero, then fires a closing burst so per-airframe weapon scalars (muzzle_v 800, rof 7 vs 6, convergence 180 vs 200, damage 28 vs 30, ammo 140 vs 170) are pinned as LIVE rounds in the sealed final snapshot. RE-DESIGNED FOR B5 (v1.21r0) with dive phases after sigma(alt) degenerated the original crossings; re-measured at v1.22r0 (g 1.6 float/fire stiffening); re-sealed at v1.24r0 (sigma-drag moved only round bytes); RE-MEASURED UNDER THE v1.25r0 TWO-SPEED BLOWER SCHEDULE (both airframes are two-speed now -- Yak-3 crit_lo 1000 / gear2 15/16 / crit 3000, La-7 crit_lo 1500 / gear2 14/16 / crit 4500 -- and their T0/v_max were re-anchored; schedule unchanged, every crossing preserved, all numbers below are v1.25r0 measurements). BONUS v1.25r0 coverage: the La-7's dive/zoom straddles its ~2825 m GEAR-SHIFT altitude, so the two-speed max() FLIPS SIDES twice in the sealed bytes -- HIGH->LOW gear at t~1696 diving through 2825 m, LOW->HIGH back at t~2336 zooming out -- while the Yak-3 flies entirely in its HIGH (FS) gear above its own crit (lapse ~0.894 at 3500 m, the falling FS branch). AC0 (Yak-3, equator, psi 90, 3500 m, TAS 150 -- strictly inside the [120,160] LUT segment): phase 0 commands bank 70 deg (over-limit -> the interpolated phi_max clamp binds ~47-48 deg, roll_rate(V) slew shapes the roll-in) at g 1.35 / full throttle -- a gently descending accelerating spiral that crosses the 160 m/s breakpoint UPWARD at t~1124; phase 1 (t=1500) reverses to bank -20 at g 1.3 / throttle 0 -- the ~68 deg reversal exercises the roll_rate slew in the [160,185] segment while the zoom + induced drag bleed TAS back DOWN through 160 at t~1873; phase 2 (t=2500) levels; phase 3 (t=2800) fires to the end -- 29 rounds at rof 7 (ammo 140->111), all inside the 250-tick TTL at tick 3000. TAS stays in [145.4, 164.1], gamma in [-4.1, +3.8] deg. AC1 (La-7, lat 10 / lon 180, psi 270, 3000 m, TAS 110 -- strictly inside the [85,125] segment): phase 0 commands bank -60 (over-limit -> clamps at the interpolated ~-52 deg) at g 1.62 / full throttle in HIGH gear at the flat 14/16 rating; phase 1 (t=1000) pushes over to g 0.05 full throttle -- the dive builds TAS through the 125 m/s breakpoint UPWARD at t~1214 and on to ~150.4 while altitude falls to ~2705 m, dropping through the gear-shift at t~1696 into the LOW (MS) gear (sigma RISES as it descends -- the B5 coupling, now on the low blower); phase 2 (t=1800) is a 1 s g 8.0 pull at bank 30 -- n_aero stays in [9.03, 9.32] > 8 through the pull, so the STRUCTURAL limit (n_max_struct 8) is the binding B3 clamp throughout; phase 3 (t=1900) is a g 3.0 wings-level ZOOM (back UP through the gear-shift at t~2336 -- the max() returns to the HIGH gear -- and TAS bleeds back DOWN through 125 at t~2405); phase 4 (t=2500) bleeds hard at g 1.6 / throttle 0 (induced drag rises with n^2); phase 5 (t=2800) fires to the end at g 1.6 / throttle 0.7 while TAS falls DOWN through the 85 m/s breakpoint at t~2858 (three LUT segments visited), ending ~72.7 m/s in a nose-high mush (gamma ~+80 deg, inside the documented +/-90 deg model envelope) -- 34 rounds at rof 6 (ammo 170->136). No round can connect (owner-excluded, nearest foreign target ~40 km): hp/regions stay full, kills 0, last_hit_by -1 -- this golden pins TRAJECTORY + weapon-scalar determinism, not combat (Hit/Winchester/EngineOut own those). Exercises: piecewise-linear LUT interpolation at non-breakpoint TAS for both envtab entries, LUT segment switches in both directions, the phi_max clamp + roll_rate slew, both B3 load-factor clamps (the aero ceiling in the Yak-3 reversal, the structural limit in the La-7 pull), B1 thrust/drag integration with both aero parameter sets, the B5 sigma(alt) LUT across a ~650 m dive/zoom band, the v1.25r0 two-speed max() flipping sides in BOTH directions plus the falling FS branch on the second ship, and the G3/G4/v1.15r0 weapon scalar set live in the snapshot bytes.
header.introduced: first golden covering the Yak-3/La-7 generated envelope-table entries (added post-v1.19r0, code 223ebd5, originally no-seal riding v1.19r0); schedules RE-DESIGNED at B5 (v1.21r0) against measured ISA-atmosphere dynamics, then RE-MEASURED at v1.22r0 (supercharger critical altitude) with the two La-7 tail phases stiffened to g 1.6 to restore the 85 m/s crossing rated power had un-bled, see ADR-Step8-FlightModel-Supercharger-v1.22r0.
